title: Three Ticker Styles, One Flicker-Free Week View | vitalii.no
description:
The kitchen kiosk calendar only ever showed the current day's grid, so there was no way to see what family events were coming up later in the week, or the week after. What was needed was a compact strip for upcoming non-sport events that wouldn't crowd out the main grid or pull attention away from it.

Three attempts went in and out in a single day. First, a static list of the next 14 days (stretching the backend window from 7 to 14 days to match) — it felt flat. Then two lines scrolling right-to-left, TV-news-ticker style, which looked busy but kept distracting on a screen meant to be glanced at, not watched. Then paging instead of scrolling, calmer, but still shifting every few seconds. The one that stuck: static blocks that wrap onto multiple lines and shrink their own font to fit, so nothing moves at all.

The kiosk now shows two weeks of non-sport events as plain, static text that holds still — after ruling out both scrolling and paging because, in the project's own commit note, they 'flicker and get in the way.'
